author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hey, Goldie here!

So, I recently just finished my map using your suggestions (:
I've made some large changes like the spawn being underground to act as a re-spawn timer and being able to jump from the iron to the middle to increase the fun of game-play, and some little ones that I didn't really think much of: adding a special island for the monuments, making everything more round, and adding in more parkour. I have lots of free-time now since it's summer, so if you find anything that should be modified or improved upon, please tell me-- it made my map a lot better once I updated it! If not, I'll be uploading this to "Map Submissions" when I feel it's ready. I hope you like it!

replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body:
Really? Thank you everyone, but I didn't think anyone really liked it... I was about to comment on how I was going to give up and try to make a different map... I guess I'll work on it some more tomorrow (:  
May I ask how I should improve my game-play? I know a big problem is the oposing team can't really get past the other team's spawn without getting noticed.. I'm just not sure how to fix this. Maybe a bridge under the middle, a ring around the map or both sides? I'm pretty clueless right now; I could really use some help! Thanks once again for the support, I'll try as hard as I can to make this map better :D

Also, I'll gladly accept any help and will put whoever helped's name on a sign of who created the map :3  I can't really make this an online server, but if you want, you can edit the map (You only need to do one half-- I have worldedit and can copy and paste it if I like the modifications you make) and put the download in one of your comments. I can then take your ideas and combine them with mine and make the map as good as possible! (:
